description: Puts files into a file input (no OS file picker shown to the user). Give ref of the file input (<input type=file> or its label), or for a site's custom "attach" button, click it first with browser_click (CDPM intercepts the picker) and call without ref. The site gets the same events as a human file pick.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

files.description: File paths on this PC (absolute recommended)

multiSlot.description: true only when one agent must handle several slots together (e.g. comparing). Normally omit (one agent = one slot; use subagents for the rest)

read.description: Append the page after the action (no separate read needed): text=body text, snapshot=snapshot page 1 (with refs), changes=only lines added/removed since your last snapshot (shortest; full page if the page changed)

ref.description: File input ref. Omit to use the file picker just opened by a click

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

summary.description: One-line note of what you are doing (e.g. "comparing laptop prices"). Shown in browser_status (not the status line). Omit to keep the previous one.

tab.description: Target tab: number (1, 2…) or ID ("t7"). Use the stable ID when agents share a slot. Required for action tools when there are multiple tabs.

name: browser_upload
title: Upload file
